Privacy Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026

This policy explains how KenganSocial (Pty) Ltd ("KenganSocial", "we") collects, uses, shares and protects personal information when you use KenganSocial, and the choices and rights you have. We are the responsible party under the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA).

1. Who we are

  • KenganSocial (Pty) Ltd (registration number [to be completed])
  • Address: [to be completed]
  • Information Officer: [to be completed], privacy@kengansocial.com
  • General and support: info@kengansocial.com
  • Billing: billing@kengansocial.com

2. Information we collect

From you: your name, email address and password (or Google sign-in), workspace and business details, your POPIA and marketing choices, the videos, images, music, captions and other content you upload or create, messages you write, and support requests.

From the social accounts you connect (only after you sign in with that platform and approve the permissions it shows you):

PlatformWhat we accessWhy
Facebook (Page)Your Page ID, name, profile picture and follower count; a Page access token; your app-scoped Facebook user ID.To publish the posts and videos you create or schedule to that Page, and show it in your workspace.
Instagram (professional account)Your account ID, username and follower count; insights (reach, interactions, followers) and your recent posts’ captions, links and like/comment counts; direct messages sent to your account and the sender’s name, username and profile picture; opt-outs; access tokens; your app-scoped Facebook user ID.To publish Reels you create or schedule, show analytics, and let you read and answer your DMs, including automated replies and lead capture you switch on.
TikTokYour open ID, display name and avatar; posting options TikTok allows for your account (privacy levels, interaction settings, maximum video length); the status of posts you publish; access tokens.To publish the videos you create, with the settings you choose on the post screen, and show which account you are posting to.
YouTubeYour channel ID, title, thumbnail and subscriber count; your video list and comments (shown live, not stored); channel analytics (views, likes, comments, shares, subscribers gained and lost); access tokens.To upload the videos you create or schedule, list and manage your uploads, show comments and show analytics.

Automatically: technical and security logs (IP address, browser, pages used, errors) and data your browser stores for the app to work: your sign-in session, and editor projects and media saved in your browser (IndexedDB) so your work is not lost. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics trackers.

Payments: Paystack processes your payment details; we receive your email, plan and a payment reference, never your full card number.

Giving us your account details is necessary to use the Service. Connecting social accounts and using AI or messaging features is voluntary; without them, those features do not work.

3. How we use it, and why we may

  • To provide the Service you asked for: publishing, scheduling, editing, analytics, messaging and AI tools (performing our contract with you).
  • To keep accounts and the Service secure, prevent abuse and fix problems (our legitimate interest, and legal obligations).
  • To process payments and keep tax records (contract and legal obligation).
  • To send service messages about your account. We send marketing emails only if you opted in, and every one has an unsubscribe link (POPIA section 69).

We use information from connected accounts only to provide the features you use in your workspace. We do not sell it, use it for advertising, or use it to build profiles of people.

4. AI and automated processing

When you use an AI feature, we send the content needed for that task (for example a transcript, caption draft, image prompt or the text of a DM you want a reply for) to an AI provider listed below, which returns a result to you. Providers process it under their API terms. We do not use your content or data from connected accounts to train AI models, and we do not send data from connected accounts to AI providers except to perform a task you asked for.

Automated DM replies and keyword rules run only if you switch them on; you can review the inbox and switch them off at any time. We do not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about anyone based solely on automated processing.

5. Who we share information with

We use these service providers (operators) to run the Service. They may process personal information only for us, under contracts that require them to keep it secure:

  • Google Cloud and Firebase: sign-in, database (Firestore, Johannesburg region), file storage, servers, and Gemini AI.
  • Vercel: hosting of the website.
  • Paystack: payments.
  • OpenAI, OpenRouter, Perplexity and Pollinations: AI text, captions and images, when you use those features.
  • AssemblyAI: speech-to-text for captions, when enabled.
  • A Redis queue provider (job scheduling) and an S3-compatible storage provider (media files).
  • Pexels, Openverse, ccMixter and Audiomack: we send your search terms when you search their stock media or music; no personal information is sent.

We also share information with the social platforms you connect, as needed to do what you ask (for example the video and caption you publish), with people you invite to your workspace, and where the law requires it. We never sell personal information.

6. Transfers outside South Africa

Some providers above, and the social platforms you connect, process information outside South Africa (for example in the United States and the European Union). We transfer it only where POPIA section 72 allows: the recipient is bound by law or a binding agreement that gives adequate protection, the transfer is needed to provide the Service you asked for, or you consent.

7. How long we keep it

  • Account and workspace data: while your account exists. When you delete your account it is deleted straight away, and removed from backups within 30 days.
  • Connected-account data: while the account is connected. When you disconnect, we revoke our access at the platform, delete the access tokens immediately, and delete the data that connection brought in (its stored analytics, and DMs, opt-outs and message leads for Instagram) within 7 days.
  • YouTube data is refreshed or deleted at least every 30 days. If you remove our access in your Google account, we delete your YouTube data within 30 days.
  • Analytics snapshots: 7, 30, 90 or 730 days depending on your plan (YouTube figures for at most 30 days).
  • Payment and tax records: as long as tax law requires (generally 5 years).

8. Security

We protect information with encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest, encrypt social-account access tokens with AES-256-GCM, limit access to people who need it, and require sign-in for every workspace action. If a security compromise affects your information, we will tell you and the Information Regulator as POPIA section 22 requires.

9. Your rights

Under POPIA you may ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, object to its processing, and withdraw consent you gave. You can:

  • download all your data: Dashboard › Settings › Privacy & data › Download my data;
  • delete your account and data: Dashboard › Settings › Privacy & data › Delete account (see our Data Deletion page);
  • disconnect any social account: Dashboard › Connections;
  • or email our Information Officer at privacy@kengansocial.com. We respond within 30 days.

You may complain to the Information Regulator (South Africa): Woodmead North Office Park, 54 Maxwell Drive, Woodmead, Johannesburg, 2191; POPIAComplaints@inforegulator.org.za; 010 023 5200; inforegulator.org.za.

Our PAIA manual is available on request from privacy@kengansocial.com.

10. YouTube and Google

KenganSocial uses YouTube API Services. By connecting YouTube you agree to the YouTube Terms of Service; Google’s use of your information is described in the Google Privacy Policy.

We access, store and use YouTube data as described in sections 2, 3 and 7: your channel details, uploads, comments and analytics, only to show them in your workspace and to upload the videos you choose. We do not share YouTube data with third parties except our operators that host the Service.

You can disconnect YouTube under Dashboard › Connections, and you can revoke KenganSocial’s access at any time from your Google account’s security settings.

KenganSocial’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

11. Facebook and Instagram

We use Meta’s APIs as described in sections 2 and 3. Instagram direct messages are visible to people who manage your linked Facebook Page or Instagram account, and to members of your KenganSocial workspace who can open the inbox.

To delete the data we hold from Facebook or Instagram, disconnect the account under Dashboard › Connections, delete your KenganSocial account, or remove KenganSocial from your Facebook settings (Settings & privacy › Settings › Business integrations). When you remove it there, Meta tells us and we delete that data automatically; you can check the status on our Data Deletion page. Meta’s own handling of your data is described in the Meta Privacy Policy.

12. TikTok

We use TikTok’s Login Kit and Content Posting API as described in sections 2 and 3. We keep your TikTok profile details and tokens only while TikTok is connected. Disconnecting revokes our access at TikTok and deletes them; you can also remove KenganSocial in the TikTok app under Settings and privacy › Security › Manage app permissions. TikTok’s handling of your data is described in the TikTok Privacy Policy.

13. Children

KenganSocial is for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.

14. Changes to this policy

We will post any changes here with a new date, and tell you by email or in the app before important changes take effect. If a change means we would use information in a new way, we will ask for your consent first.
